title: Selective creatinine testing and laboratory representation in perioperative acute kidney injury prediction: identity-consistent reanalysis code and aggregate results
description: Author-approved research-software release v4.0.0 for R2_IDQC_20261113. Contains portable analysis and testing-time code, independent grouped-calibration code, synthetic tests, provenance, disclosure-controlled aggregate CSVs, and the unchanged 44-sheet results workbook. Supersedes v3.4.0 for the current identity-consistent reanalysis; historical versions remain available. Prepared-R2 numerical consistency and synthetic raw-route validation are documented; full real raw-to-R2 equivalence and a fresh real 1000-replicate full-chain bootstrap were not established by the distribution validation. No raw or row-level patient data, individual predictions, serialized models, bootstrap replicates, manuscripts or confidential reviewer material are distributed. Original code is MIT-licensed; original documentation and permitted aggregate content are CC BY 4.0. Provider data-access conditions remain applicable. This is research software, not an accepted journal publication or a clinically validated deployment.
